hooks.command: grep -q "git commit" && cd "/c/Users/cgclark/Documents/Claude/dossier" && for f in dossier build.sh; do m=$(git ls-files -s -- "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk "{print \$1}"); if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "100755" ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"WARNING: $f lost its executable bit (mode $m) after a commit -- Windows checkouts do not track +x. Fix: git update-index --chmod=+x $f && git commit --amend --no-edit\"}"; fi; done || true
